title: India may approve $370 million China-backed Horse Powertrain investment for hybrid engine production: Report
summary: India is expected to approve a $370 million investment by China-backed Horse Powertrain to build hybrid engines and powertrains locally, marking one of the biggest Chinese-linked manufacturing investments in years.
